answer: Yes, <mark> adduser</mark> is nothing but a symbolic link to <mark>useradd</mark> so both will create a new account.
description:
Creating new user account is the one of the Basic Linux administrator activity.

As a root user, to create new user simple run
useradd giis

Above command will create a new user named 'giis'.

By default, user's home directory will be created under /home directory You can view this via command.

ls -ld /home/giis

We have used useradd command to create a new user, do you think adduser is a valid command?
name: Creating User account

description:
The new user we created in previous step has the home directory. But he/she can't login to his account. Because by default Linux doesn't assign any password, we need to set them using passwd command.

You can set the password for the user with command like

passwd giis 

Changing password for user giis.
New password: 
Retype new password:


If everything went well you must be seeing a message like

passwd: all authentication tokens updated successfully. Right?
name: Setting up password

description:
Lets check whether new user and his/her password is actually working fine.

Linux provides su switch user command to login as another user. Lets use that command to login to our new account .

su giis

After providing the password for that account, you will be logged in as 'giis'

To confirm that you are indeed user giis, run the command

whoami

which will give your current userid. And also at any point of time, logged in user can move to their home directory with simple command

cd ~

to view current directory path, type

pwd

Did it say /home/giis ?

In this short tutorial, we saw how to create a new user account and setup their password and finally verified the account with commands like su,whoami,cd ~,pwd
name: Verification
